1.o: سرق الإدعشري ذهب أبو إبراهيم وقتل الحارس أبو سمعو وحاول أبناء الحارة البحث عن الفاعل.

2.o: انصدمت زوجة الإدعشري بعد دفن زوجها لجثة أبو سمعو في مدفن بيتهم، عانت بوران بسبب معاملة زوجها السيئة لها.

3.o: شك أبو إبراهيم أن الإدعشري هو سارق الذهب بعد رؤيته لحذائه في بيته وقرر الزعيم أبو صالح التأكد وفتش بيته لكنه لم يجد شيء.

4.o: عذب أبو جودت- الإدعشري بعد تقديم أبو إبراهيم شكوى ضده أنه سارق الذهب.

5.o: تسلم أبو ماجد حراسة الحارة، رفض الإدعشري الاعتراف على الرغم من تعذيب أبو جودت له.

6.o: طلب الزعيم أبو صالح من أبو إبراهيم التنازل عن حقه للإفراج عن الإدعشري، طلب أبو حسن من الزعيم مساعدتهم لمساندة أهل فلسطين وتوصيل سلاح لهم.

7.o: قرر الإدعشري تخليص نفسه واتهم أبو سمعو وقرر أبو شهاب مراقبة الإدعشري؛ وفي النهاية تنازل أبو إبراهيم عن حقه.

8.o: ترك الإدعشري الحارة بعد معرفته بمراقبة أبو شهاب له؛ وطلب أبو صالح من أبو النار التدخل لعودته للحارة.

9.o: حرض الإدعشري أبو النار ضد أهل حارة الضبع وبدأوا بخطتهم، توفيت عمة أبو النار وقدم أهل حارة الضبع واجب العزاء.

10.o: أخبر الإدعشري- أبو النار بمضايقة أهل حارة الضبع لأنه بعد موت عمته أصبح البيت له، اتضح أن زهرة بعد إصابتها بالحمى وهي صغيرة فقدت السمع والنطق.

11.o: علم عصام عن ضرب سعيد لشقيقته بران وأهانه معتز وعاتب أبو عصام أولاده.

12.o: قرر أبو خاطر أن يزوج ابنته زهرة لرياض وسيتكفل بمصاريف الزواج، أوصل أبو شهاب لرجال الثورة الفلسطنية أموال لشراء سلاح، وافق أبو دراع على زواجه من شفيقة ابنة الإدعشري.

13.o: تزوجت شفيقة من أبو دراع، قرر أبو عصام أن يزوج ابنه عصام من لطفية ولكن قررت سعاد عدم إتمام الزواج بسبب خلافها مع فريال.

14.o: علم أبو عصام عن كذب سعاد عليه وصمم على زواج عصام ولطفية وأجبر سعاد على زيارتهم لطلبها بشكل رسمي.

15.o: اعتذرت فريال من سعاد بأمر من أبو صالح واتفقوا على ميعاد الزواج واستعدت كلًا من العائلتين.

16.o: قرر أهل الحارة مساعدة أبو إبراهيم في أزمته، علم أبو خاطر عن أخلاق رياض العالية ورعايته لأخواته، توفت زوجة الإدعشري بعد مصارعتها مع المرض.

17.o: تم عقد قران عصام ولطفية، قرر أبو شهاب وضع حد لتصرفات أبو النار، خرب خاطر عمل رياض بسبب غيرته الشديدة منه.

18.o: عاتب أبو خاطر ابنه لإيذائه لرياض، قرر سمعو التطوع بالشرطة، رعى الزعيم شاب متسول يدعي صطيف فاقد لعقله.

19.o: عرض أبو خاطر على رياض الزواج من زهرة وتكفله بكل شيء وأخبره عن فقدانها للسمع والتكلم، في ظل محاولات الإدعشري معاملة أبنائه بطريقة قاسية.

20.o: وافق رياض على زواجه من زهرة واطمئن أبو خاطر ولكن شعر خاطر أن رياض يطمع في ثروة والده وقرر عدم إتمام الزواج.

21.o: وقف الإدعشري مع أهل حارة الضبع ضد أبو النار للوصول لهدفه وهو عودته إلى بيته.

22.o: رفض خاطر الذهاب للعمل على الرغم من ذلك تم عقد قران رياض وزهرة وسط فرحة والدها.

23.o: شك أبو شهاب بسطيف بعد تهجم الشرطة على بيته، أقيم زفاف زهرة ورياض، طلب أبو النار من أبو غالب مراقبة الإدعشري.

24.o: قررت الحكومة وضع سيطرتها على الأراضي المأخوذة بدون حق وقرر الإدعشري الإسراع في خروج الذهب من مدفن جده.

25.o: استعد عصام لزفافه ولكن لم تكتمل فرحته حيث تم إلغاء الزفاف لوفاة صالح ابن الزعيم.

26.o: تهجمت الشرطة على الثوار وتوفي الزيبق، توفي معروف بعد لدغ ثعبان له، تأكد أبو شهاب أن هناك جاسوس بالحارة.

27.o: شعر الإدعشري بتأنيب الضمير بعد وفاة ابنه معروف، لم يتحمل رياض معاملة خاطر السيئة له وقرر وضع حد لهذه المشكلة.

28.o: يداوي أبو عصام- أبو حسن بعد إصابته، تنازل رياض عن الأملاك لأبو خاطر وأقام في بيت عائلته، ومن ناحية أخرى تزوج عصام من لطفية.

29.o: اعتذر خاطر من رياض، قبض الإدعشري على أبو ساطور بعد محاولته حرق محل أبو شهاب، تم بتر ذراع الإدعشري بعد إصابته بالغرغرينة ووقف معه أهل الحارة.

30.o: طلب أبو شهاب من شباب الحارة حراستها، توفي ابن أبو حاتم الرضيع وحاول أهل الحارة التهوين عليه.

31.o: ترك أبو دراع ترك العمل مع أبو النار، علم أبو شهاب عن نية أبو النار في إيذائه، حاول الإدعشري إخبار الزعيم عن سرقته للذهب لعدم تحمله.

32.o: أخبر الإدعشري أعضاء الحارة أنه سارق ذهب أبو إبراهيم وقتله لأبو سمعو وطلب منهم مسامحته وتوفى بعدها.

33.o: باع صبحي البيت وترك الحارة بعد فعلة والده، قُتل أبو سمير وبحث الزعيم وراء مقتله واتضح أن سطيف هو الجاسوس.

1.o: بدأت الأحداث بتلقي الحارة خبر استشهاد أبو عصام وبعد مرور برهة من الوقت طلب أبو شهاب من شقيقته وأولادها تخطي أزمتهم ونسيان الحزن على فراق أبو عصام.

2.o: رفض معتز الزواج بعد وفاة والده، تشرطت فريال لعودة لطفية لعصام، اتفق أبو شهاب مع أبو إبراهيم لإتمام زواج دلال.

3.o: قرر أبو غالب الزواج من أرملة أبو سمير وعرض أبو النار على أهل الحارة استئجار محل أبو سمير لأبو غالب لكنهم رفضوا.

4.o: قرر أبو غالب الانتقام من أبو حاتم، أما إبراهيم فتزوج من دلال، رفض أبو حاتم أن يزوج أحدى بناته لعبده، اتضح أن حمدي جاسوس وينقل معلومات للإنجليز.

5.o: توفيت أم خاطر بعد وقوع لها حادثة، عاد عصام إلى لطفية، طلب أبو شهاب من أبو حاتم يد ابنته للزواج.

6.o: طلب أبو حسن من معتز تبليغ أبو شهاب عن تزويد أهل فلسطين بالسلاح، تزوجت شريفة من أبو شهاب، أما زهرة فأنجبت صبي.

7.o: استلم أبو شهاب السلاح، يجمع أدهم أصدقائه ﻹشعال ثورة ضد الجيش الفرنسي.

8.o: بدأت الصراعات بين هدى ولطفية، أبو جودت يبتز نوري، تم توصيل السلاح للفلسطينيين من قبل شباب الحارة.

9.o: قرر أبو غالب الانتقام من أبو بشير وخرب عمله، شك أبو عرب بصبحي وطلب من أبو صياح مراقبته.

10.o: أنجبت لطفية فتاة وتمت المصالحة بين فريال وسعاد، قرر أبو خاطر زواج ابنته خيرية من كمال، وقف البيع في المخبز أبو بشير بسبب أبو غالب.

11.o: انزعج معتز بعد معرفته بزواج خيرية، مرض إبو إبراهيم وطلب الطبيب من ابنه نقله إلى المستشفى.

12.o: علم أبو بشير أن أبو غالب هو من أذاه، وتوفى أبو إبراهيم، وداوى الطبيب حمزة- أم حاتم وعرض عليه أبو حاتم الإقامة في الحارة لمداواة المرضي، قام الفرنساوي بقتل طفل صغير في حارة الضبع.

13.o: زور الضابط الفرنسي التقرير الطبي الخاص بعرب الطفل المتوفي وقرر أبو عرب الأخذ بثأر ابنه من حارة الضبع، رفع أبو نصوح دعوى ضد إبراهيم لاحتياله على بيت والده.

14.o: قرر سمعو الأخذ بثأر والده بعد ألتحاقة بالشرطة، تشاجرت فريال مع أم بشير، حرض حمدي- أبو عرب ضد حارة الضبع.

15.o: قرر سمعو فتح التحقيق ضد حارة الضبع لمعرفة قاتل والده، طلب عصام من والدته بيع البيت لإنهاء الخلاف بين زوجاته لكنها رفضت.

16.o: قرر إبراهيم عدم التفريط في حقه، حاول حمدي قتل أبو شهاب للإيقاع بين حارة الماوي وحارة الضبع، قرر كمال أخذ خيرية بالقانون بما أنه عقد القران عليها ولكن لم يقبل خاطر ووالده.

17.o: اتفق أبو النار مع أبو عرب ضد أهل حارة الضبع، حُرقت مقهي أبو حاتم ووقف معه شباب الحارة لتنضيفها من جديد.

18.o: قرر أبو جودت إيذاء نوري وسرق مسدسه، عاتب أبو شهاب- عصام ومعتز لعدم معاونة شقيقتهم بوران بعد مرض زوجها، أما خيرية فتم طلاقها.

19.o: قررت بوران توسيع عملها في التفصيل، حاول أبو حاتم الإصلاح بين حارة الماوي وحارته ولكن لم يقبل أبو عرب، اتحد أدهم مع أبو شهاب ضد الجيش الفرنسي.

20.o: تصالح أبو صياح مع أبو شهاب وأهل الحارة وحاول تهدئة أبو عرب، قدم سعيد ابنه فدية لأبو صياح لكنه لم يقبل سفك دم طفل صغير.

21.o: قرر معتز بدأ العمل مع خاطر، اشترى أبو عرب بيت أبو النار لمضايقة حارة الضبع.

22.o: معتز خطب خيرية، قرر أبو حاتم زواج مسلم من إحدى بناته، قتل صبحي ضابط فرنسي حاول التحرش بإحدى السيدات.

23.o: فك سمعو أسر صبحي، علم أبو صياح أن حمدي هو الجاسوس وقتله، أما أبو شهاب فخلص الثوار وتهجم الضباط الإنجليز  على حارة الضبع ووقفوا لهم أهل الحارة.

1.o: كلير ممرضة بريطانية تعالج المصابين في الحرب العالمية الثانية، تنتقل بشكل غامض عبر الزمن إلى القرن الثامن عشر في سكوتلاندا. تلتقي بمجموعة من رجال الثورة السكوتلاندية من بينهم شاب مصاب يدعى جيمي.

2.o: تؤخذ كلير إلى قصر ليوخ، ويتصاعد شك سكان المنطقة بهويتها، وهي بدورها تقوم بالتقرب من جيليس دانكن. عندما يكتشف زعماء المنطقة خبرتها الطبية، تنتقل كلير من كونها ضيفة إلى سجينة.

3.o: تقوم كلير من خلال عملها في معالجة المرضى، بمعالجة طفل كانت حالته الصحية متدهورة للغاية. وتجد طريقة قد تساعدها في الهروب من القصر.

4.o: يأتي الوقت المناسب للهرب خلال حفلة ينظمها القصر. ولكن يتعرقل مخططها بعد لقائها مع دوغل وجيمي.

5.o: تنضم كلير إلى الماكينزي في جولتهم لجمع الأجور. ويقوم دوغل باستغلال جيمي ليحصل على شفقة السكان. تتذكر كلير بأن حدثاً تاريخياً مهماً على وشك الوقوع.

6.o: تقوم كلير بمقابلة الجنرال البريطاني، ولكن تضطرب الأوضاع مع وصول الكابتن جاك راندل. يستغل راندل الموقف لينفرد بكلير لوحده، ويضغط عليها للبوح بكل ما تخبئه.

7.o: تجبر كلير وجيمي على الزواج، ولكن يكتشف الاثنان أن كلاهما يكن مشاعراً للآخر. والآن كلير واقعة في صراع بين زوجها في العالم الآخر وزوجها في هذا الزمن.

8.o: يحاول فرانك العثور على كلير بكل طريقة ممكنة. وكلير تحاول التأقلم مع حياتها الزوجية الحالية.

9.o: يقوم جيمي ومجموعته بإنقاذ كلير من بين يدي جاك راندل. وفي القصر، تتصاعد بعض المشاكل السياسية التي من الممكن أن تؤثر سلباً على عائلة الماكينزي. وحبيبة جيمي السابقة تحاول استرجاعه.

10.t: By the Pricking of My Thumbs
10.o: يأمل جيمي بأن الديوك الجديد للمنطقة سيقوم بإلغاء المبلغ المطلوب على رأسه. في الوقت الذي تحاول فيه كلير إنقاذ طفل يتيم.

11.o: توضع كلير وجيليس تحت المحاكمة بتهمة الشعوذة. ينجح جيمي في إنقاذ كلير، ولكن كلير تكتشف سراً عن ماضي جيليس.

12.o: بعد اتحادهما من جديد، يتوجه جيمي وكلير إلى منزل عائلة جيمي في لاليبروخ. تتكشف أسرار قديمة، وجروح من الماضي تعود من جديد.

13.o: يشعر جيمي بالتشتت مع ظهور شخصية من ماضيه. وكلير تأخذ على عاتقها توليد أخت جيمي في الوقت الذي ينضم في هو وزوج أخته إلى مهمة حربية.

14.o: تنطلق كلير وجيني للعثور على جيمي. ولكن تعود جيني أدراجها بعد انضمام مورتاغ إلى كلير في المهمة. فيقوم الاثنان باستخدام أسلوب مختلف لإيجاده.

15.o: تنطلق كلير إلى سجن ونتوورث لإنقاذ جيمي، حيث تدور الأقدار ليقع جيمي في قبضة بلاك جاك راندل.

16.o: تضع كلير خطة محكمة لإخراج جيمي من السجن، ولكن الأذى النفسي الذي حل به يسيطر عليه تماماً.

1.o: بعد عودتها إلى عالمها، يتوجب على كلير التعايش مع حاضرها ونسيان الحياة التي تركتها.

2.o: الحياة في فرنسا ليست سهلة وجيمي يحاول يائساً التغلب على الماضي. لقاء مع الأمير تشارلز يقدم فرصاً مهمة.

3.o: تجد كلير العزاء في قدراتها العلاجية خلال تقدمها وجيمي في مخطط إيقاف كولودن. ولكن يأتي الماضي ليقف في طريقهما!

4.o: يقيم جيمي وكلير حفلة عشاء، سعياً لتأخير مساعي الأمير تشارلز. في هذه الأثناء تعلم كلير أن جاك راندال على قيد الحياة.

5.o: يحاول الثنائي إشعال النيران من جديد، وكلير ستواجه مصيراً جديداً. علاقة جيمي وكلير تحت الاختبار.

6.o: يستخدم جيمي وكلير أساليب الطبابة الخاصة بكلير لتساعدهما في مخططاتهما. تدرك كلير أن جيمي تراجع عن وعده.

7.o: يتم إحضار كلير إلى المستشفى لإنقاذ حياتها وحياة جنينها. يطلب الملك لويس من كلير إصدار الحكم على رجلين متهمان بقضية جدّية.

8.o: يقوم الثنائي بطلب مساعدة جد جيمي اللورد لوفات. وأما كولوم ماكينزي الزائر، فلديه مخططات أخرى.

9.o: يجتمع كلير وجيمي من جديد مع لاليبروك وماكينزي. يزداد الضغط على الثنائي مع صراع السلطة والحروب الشخصية.

10.o: مع ثقته بمعلومات كلير عن التاريخ، يقوم جيمي بقيادة الجيش إلى حرب مع البريطانيين.

11.o: يتم إرسال كلير والمجموعة إلى الشمال خلف قائد الجاكوبايت.

12.o: يحاول جيمي جاهداً تعذيب جيش الجاكوبايت، وكلير تقرر مواجهة أليكس راندال.

13.o: في المستقبل، تزور كلير الماضي وتطلع ابنتها على الحقيقة. وأما في القرن الـ18 فيحين وقت الحرب وجيمي يحاول المستحيل لحماية حياة من يحب.

1.o: ماضي جيمي يقدم له طريقاً للنجاة، وكلير الحامل تحاول التأقلم مع حياتها بعيداً عن جيمي.

2.o: جيمي يمضي قدماً في حياة العزلة، وجيوش البريطانيين يحاولون العثور عليه.

3.o: يدرك جيمي في السجن أن عدو قديم أصبح مسؤولاً، وبإمكانه تدمير حياته.

4.o: جيمي يدخل إلى حياة عائلة بريطانية نبيلة.

5.o: روجر يحضر لكلير بعض المعلومات المهمة، والتي تجبرها على اتخاذ قرار مصيري.

6.o: بعد الانفصال لمدة أعوام طويلة، كلير وجيمي يجتمعان من جديد.

7.o: بعد مواجهة عنيفة، تحاول كلير اتخاذ قرار طبي، قد يعرض حياتها وجيمي إلى خطر.

8.o: تعود كلير إلى لاليبروك مع جيمي، ولكن لا تلقى الترحيب الذي كانت تتوقعه.

9.o: يتوجه جيمي وكلير إلى سكوتلاندا، في مهمة مصيرية.

10.o: تحاول كلير السيطرة على داء انتشر على متن سفينة.

11.o: بعد أن سلمت للأقدار، ينتهي المطاف بكلير على جزيرة نائية.

12.o: تصل السفينة أخيراً إلى جامايكا، حيث يقترب جيمي وكلير أكثر وأكثر من هدفهما.

13.o: تدخل كلير في صراع مع الوقت في محاولة إنقاذ شخص عزيز عليها.

1.o: كلير وجيمي يقابلان ستيفان بونيه، قرصان ومهرب يطلب منهما المساعدة. كلير تُحدث جيمي عن بعض أمور من التاريخ الأمريكي.

2.o: كلير وجيمي يزوران العمة جوكاستا بمزرعتها في ريفر رَن. عندما تقع مأساة في المزرعة، يجد جيمي وكلير نفسيهما عالقَين بين ما هو صحيح، وبين قانون الأرض.

3.o: جيمي وكلير يبحثان عن مكان ليكون منزلهما. في هذه الأثناء، في القرن العشرين، تشتعل العلاقة الرومانسية بين بريانا وروجر.

4.o: بعد أن قادتهم العناية الإلهية إلى فريزر ريدج. جيمي وكلير والشاب يانغ إيان يبدؤون ببناء منزل لهم في سلسة الجبال الزرقاء.

5.o: مهارات كلير الطبية تصبح في منتهى الأهمية، لكنها تخاف على حياتها بعد وقوع المأساة في منازل مرضاها.

6.o: جيمي وكلير يقعان تحت مفاجأة وصول اللورد جون غرِي إلى فريزر ريدج وبصحبته شخص آخر.

7.o: بريانا تتبع خطا والدتها وتسافر بالزمن إلى القرن الثامن عشر في اسكوتلاندا.

8.o: بحث روجر الدؤوب عن بريانا يؤتي ثماره عندما يجدها في ويلمينغتن، لكن لم شملهما العاطفي يتوقف عندما تكتشف أنه أخفى معلومات عنها.

9.o: بينما تصارع بريانا لتتخطى الصدمة التي تعرضت لها في ويلمينغتن، تصب تركيزها في العثور على والديها.

10.o: جيمي وكلير يخفيان الأسرار بعضهما عن بعض، فيما يساعدان بريانا بالتعامل مع الصدمة التي تعرضت لها مؤخراً.

11.o: بينما ينطلق جيمي وكلير والشاب يانغ إيان في رحلة طويلة لإنقاذ روجر، تقيم بريانا صداقة بينها وبين أحد أصدقاء جيمي القدامى.

12.o: يصادق روجر أحد الأسرى أثناء سعيه للهرب من قرية موهوك، بينما يخطط فيرغس ومارسالي لمهمة خطيرة.

13.o: تتعثر خطة جيمي وكلير والشاب يانغ إيان لإنقاذ روجر من خاطفيه، من الموهوك، عندما يظهر شبح من ماضي كلير.

1.o: تخمد الأجواء الاحتفالية في فريزر ريدج بأمر من شخصية سياسية ذات نفوذ، وحقيقة صادمة يكشف النقاب عنها.

2.o: بدعم من وحدة الجنود، يواصل جيمي مطاردته لمورتا وجماعته. عندما يموت مستوطن في ريدج بسبب مرض خطير، تشعر كلير بأن عليها اتخاذ الإجراءات اللازمة.

3.o: يقوم جيمي وكلير بمساعدة عبد لإنقاذ شقيقه التوأم من شر سيده، ولكنهما سرعان ما يكتشفان بأن الأمر أصعب مما تخيلاه.

4.o: يقود روجر ميليشيا جيمي إلى محطة براونزويل التجارية، ولكنه سرعان ما يجد نفسه في مأزق.

5.o: يصل جيمي والميليشيا إلى هيلزبورو، ويكتشفون بأن تايرون قام بتقديم حل غير تقليدي للتعامل مع تهديدات المنظمين.

6.o: في يوم زفاف جوكاستا، يصبح جيمي على علم بأن تهديدات الهيئات التنظيمية لا تزال مستمرة، فيما تكتشف كلير معلومات عن عدو من الماضي.

7.o: يصل تمرد المنظمين ذروته، الأمر الذي يجبر جيمي على مواجهة مخاوفه وعواقب ولائه المقسم.

8.o: يبدأ أفراد عائلة آل فريز بالتعافي من الأحداث الصادمة التي شهدوها خلال معركة ألامانس. لاحقا، يصل ضيف غير متوقع إلى ريدج.

9.o: يلتف سكان ريدج حول جيمي الذي يصارع من أجل البقاء. لاحقا، يكلف جيمي روجر بمهمة ليقوم بتنفيذها في حال وفاته.

10.o: تفشل خطة جيمي للقضاء على الخطر الذي يهدد عائلته. تجد بريانا نفسها مجبرة على الصراع من أجل حياتها وجيمي.

11.o: كشف كبير عن جيمي يجبر بريانا وروجر لاتخاذ قرارات مصيرية.

12.o: تكافح كلير للتعايش مع قسوة خاطفيها، فيما يتخذ جيمي تدابير صارمة في محاولة منه لإنقاذ زوجته.

1.o: يواصل جيمي وكلير القتال لحماية من يحبان، بينما يلوح تهديد الحرب الثورية فوق فريزر ريدج.

2.o: يعاني جيمي مع طلبه الأول كوكيل هندي. يترأس روجر جنازة غير عادية.

3.o: يقلق فيرغوس بشأن نوعية حياة ابنه الجديد عندما يتعرض الطفل للسخرية والتنمّر من البروتستانت المؤمنين بالخرافات. كلير تجري جراحة على يد توم.

4.o: يكشف إيان لجيمي حياته بين الموهوك. جيمي يخبر شيف بيرد شيئاً يجب عليه التفكير فيه، مستقبلاً.

5.o: هناك شيء ما في الجو. جيمي واللورد جون يتحدثان عن السياسة. روجر يتلقى أنباء ممتازة.

6.o: ينتشر وباء (الزحار) في منطقة ريدج، وتصاب كلير بمرض مميت.

7.o: تعاني كلير مع مخاوفها الداخلية، حين تبدأ شائعة شائنة بالانتشار على ريدج.

8.o: ريتشارد براون ولجنته للسلامة يصلان لاعتقال كلير بتهمة القتل.

1.o: Harlee Santos, a detective from a tight-knit group of Brooklyn cops with questionable tactics, is arrested by an FBI agent who wants to make her an informant.  Co-stars Ray Liotta.

2.o: Harlee struggles with becoming an FBI informant while Wozniak suspects every member of his crew.  Paranoid that Wozniak's search will lead to her, Harlee suggests polygraphng the entire crew, a plan that backfires.  An appeals case sends Wozniak to watch tapes from  his first encounter with Harlee, revealing a dark secret from their past.  Meanwhile, Espada helps Tess deal with her husband's infidelity.

3.o: Harlee refuses to give Stahl incriminating evidence against Wozniak but hands over a fully resolved unoffical investigation that Tess and Espara initiated when they moved a body by Tess' house found to be murdered with a 3D printed gun.  Wozniak confronts Harlee who executes a dangerous bluff.

4.o: Loman's guilt over the death of an unarmed suspect becomes a liability for the crew, forcing them to test his loyalty.  Wozniak sends Harlee on an errand that reveals he has a silent partner in the big score.  Wozniak realizes Donny has been withholding information.  Harlee feigns cooperation with Stahl, but unwittingly leads the FBI to incrimmating evidence,

5.o: Harlee and Tess intercept a heroin shipment from a local drug lord who discovers Wozniak's secret and tries to use it as leverage to get his confiscated drugs back.  Harlee fears Stahl's interest in her goes beyond the professional, believing he is invading her privacy, and resorts to spying on him with the help of an old friend.  Tess tries to use Espada to get back at her husband.

6.o: Wozniak's suspicions land on Saperstein, forcing Harlee to convince Stahl to arrest Saperstein in order to keep him safe. Harlee visits her abusive ex, Miguel, who tasks her with tracking down the man who committed the murder for which he is imprisoned.

7.o: Wozniak finds it hard to deal with guilt as he attempts to deal with an unfinished task. Harlee needs to protect Saperstein whilst holding the unit together.

8.o: After Saperstein's death, Harlee realizes there are no lines Wozniak won't cross and decides to help Stahl's investigation. The crew retaliates against a pair of abusive cops after they harass Harlee's daughter Cristina and her boyfriend. Wozniak makes Loman feel like a part of the unit.

9.o: Harlee's collaboration with Stahl (Warren Kole) uncovers Wozniak's secret relationship with Donnie.  Wozniak decides to take charge of the big job after picking up a package that turns out to be a kidnapped man.  A mysterious call to Saperstein's desk forces the crew to face their mixed feelings about their fallen friend and ultimately decide to preserve his memory.

10.o: Harlee and Wozniak secure more details on the big score and meet Donnie's silent partner, who reveals himself to be an DEA agent.  They learn the big score is an armored car heist.  Wozniak takes interest in a fellow marine veteran who is suspected of murder under dubious circumstances.

11.o: On the day of the heist, Harlee realizes she misplaced her trust in Stahl but it's too late to back down.  Harlee tries to get immunity for her crew as she participates in the heist knowing that it will lead to Wozniak's arrest.  Miguel discovers Harlee's secret.  Loman unwittingly witnesses the heist just as the exchange goes terribly wrong.

12.o: Harlee and Wozniak attempt to deal with the consequences of the heist's money disappearance. Harlee informs the FBI that she will get the money back.

13.o: Unable to provide Donnie and Linklater to the FBI, Harlee makes a deal with Stahl to exchange her own immunity for that of her crew. Harlee comes face to face with Miguel who reveals his darkest side as he demands to be a part of Cristina's life.

1.o: Harlee Santos takes drastic measures to cover up the murder of her abusive ex, Miguel. Lieutenant Matt Wozniak makes a deal with FBI Agent Robert Stahl to keep himself and his crew out of jail but soon discovers Stahl has led him into an impossible trap. As the crew deals with the fall-out from the failed heist, Tess struggles to keep her painful gunshot wound under wraps.

2.o: Following Wozniak's discovery that Stahl's target is his close friend and Mayoral Candidate, Julia Ayers, Wozniak launches an all-out war with Stahl. Meanwhile, Harlee dives into an investigation that takes an unexpected turn into her own past.

3.o: After Wozniak refuses to play ball with the FBI, Stahl turns up the heat on Harlee who lands in the middle of Wozniak's dangerous plan to free himself from the Feds by reeling in a bigger fish. Meanwhile, Internal Affairs Officer Verco  applies pressure to each member of the crew to discover what really happened to Donnie Pomp.

4.o: Realizing that Stahl will stop at nothing to arrest Julia Ayre, Harlee decides to investigate on her own and determine whether there's any truth in his allegations of Ayers active business with the mob. Wozniak is confronted with a drug case that forces him to face the darkest demons from his past, his daughter's death, while exposing the origin of his loyalty.

5.o: The mafia seeks revenge on Harlee by framing her for murder. As Harlee works against the clock and her own crew to cover her tracks as Wozniak fights to keep his cop family together when evidence of an old crime puts pressure on the already splintering team. Stahl cozies up to Cristina getting one step closer to the truth about Miguel.

6.o: Harlee and Wozniak investigate Caroline's murder, putting Harlee and Nava's relationship in an awkward place because she can't reveal her connection to the crime or the methods she will use to solve it. Wozniak focuses on determining which member of his crew is informing to Verco as Loman uncovers a much deeper secret.

7.o: Following Harlee's brave confession to the entire crew that she has been informing for the FBI, the team grapples with Harlee and Wozniak's betrayal. With their team falling apart, Harlee and Wozniak come up with a desperate plan to neutralize Bianchi. However, their actions have unforeseen consequences because the Mafia fires back.

8.o: Wozniak goes after Bianchi for breaking their agreement. Harlee seizes the opportunity to unite the team around an illegal mission to repay Tufo's brother's debt to a local drug dealer. Stahl heightens the stakes making good on his threat to go after the crew. Wozniak faces the impossible decision to pick between his team and Ayres just as his son, Nate, makes an effort to reunite.

9.o: Harlee makes the chilling discovery that someone is texting Cristina as her dead ex, "Miguel." The case of a missing kid leads Wozniak to uncover a local dealer who uses underage mules and reminds Loman of what their unit is all about. The crew gets caught in a brutal ambush.

10.o: Harlee and Wozniak lead a manhunt for the gunmen who ambushed the crew, and they unearth the key to taking down Bianchi. The crew bands together against Verco, who has evidence of their corruption. Stahl goes rogue to link Harlee to Miguel's death.

11.o: Harlee and Wozniak lead the crew on a dangerous mission to heist Bianchi's secret ledger and take down the mobster once and for all. But the plan takes a tragic turn when the events our heroes set in motion put one of their own in harms way, forcing Harlee to turn to an unlikely source for help.

12.o: Harlee helps Nava cover his tracks after a violent encounter, revealing a side of herself Nava's never seen before and putting their relationship in jeopardy. Wozniak faces a ghost from his past in order to take down a new enemy in his present. Stahl gets a critical piece of information in his hunt for the truth about Miguel.

13.o: In a dramatic confrontation, Wozniak faces the ally who betrayed him and makes his most difficult choice yet. Meanwhile, Stahl's fanatical plan to take Harlee down for murder finally pays off, forcing Harlee to get dangerously close to the man who's obsessed with her In the end, Harlee and Wozniak's desperate efforts to save themselves and the crew lead to shocking consequences for both.

7.o: Harlee fights a frame job as Wozniak tries to keep Bennett behind bars.

1.o:
Music idol Sheryl Nome arrives at the Macross Frontier fleet for a concert performance. In the meantime, fleet command deals with an unidentified & powerful alien enemy.

Overwhelmed by the new enemies' speed & power (despite their lesser numbers), fleet defenses cannot prevent some of the alien bio mecha from penetrating the main colony ship. Teenage music fan Ranka Lee, young student Saotome Alto & S.M.S. VF-25 veteran pilot Ozma Lee are all involved in the ordeal.

2.o: Ranka Lee is on her way to S.M.S. to drop off some items for her older brother Ozma Lee when she happens to meet Sheryl Nome. Alto Saotome also shows up when the two arrive at an observation park, but then the Vajra loom over from the skies above.

3.o: Alto Saotome unexpectedly meets Ranka Lee and Sheryl Nome again at an observation park. However, the Vajra also shows up in the skies above the three, so they immediately head to the park's emergency shelter and get trapped inside.

4.o: Alto Saotome is put through the paces by Mikhail Buran and the others at S.M.S. Meanwhile, Ranka Lee has passed the initial rounds of the Miss Macross contest auditions and sings a song for the very final screening stage.

5.o: Sheryl comes across Alto again in her quest to find her missing earing. She orders Alto to guide her around the Macross Frontier fleet. Elsewhere, Ozma and Ranka argue about her decision of becoming a singer.

6.o: Ranka Lee is scouted by an entertainment production company. While Sheryl is rehearsing for her Sayonara live concert on the final day of her tour, news arrives that the Macross Galaxy fleet is being attacked by a large horde of Vajra. As a result, President Howard Glass decides to inform his citizens of the new enemies' existence.

7.o: After the Macross Galaxy fleet is hit by a large-scale Vajra attack, Alto Saotome and his unit head out in the S.M.S. Macross 25 warship to rescue the surviving ships. On the same day Sheryl gives her last live concert on Macross Frontier.

8.o: Ranka transfers to Mihoshi Academy so as to be able to pursue a career in entertainment. A visit by Sheryl to Ranka's new school causes chaos in the academy.

9.o: Sheryl's manager Grace O'Connor informs Mikhail Buran about his elder sister. Mikhail gets troubled by it and during a battle with the Vajra he almost hits Alto Saotome by mistake, which causes trouble between the two.

10.o: Ranka Lee is contracted to act in a minor role during a movie about the legend of Shin Kudo, while Sheryl Nome is the main female protagonist of the film.

11.o: Ranka prepares a special gift for Alto's approaching birthday.

12.o: Sheryl gives a consolation concert at planet Galia 4, but because of an undisclosed illness she cancels her concert, which causes a huge riot.

13.o: Alto and Ranka make an emergency landing in planet Galia 4 due to a malfunction with their variable fighter.

14.o: The secret of "Aimo", the lullaby that only Ranka and Brera know is finally revealed.

15.o: While Sheryl is recovering from her illness, all her work is cancelled. When she is informed that Ranka's popularity is now rising she becomes insecure and worried about her own musical career. During that time, Alto and Ranka give her a friendly visit.

16.o: Mr. Bilrer, the owner of S.M.S. meets with Alto Saotome. At the same time, Ranka finds out that Brera, the pilot of the hostile VF-27, has been listening to her songs.

17.o: Ozma promises Ranka to attend her first live concert on Macross Frontier, but he is ordered to defend the fleet from another Vajra attack before that.

18.o: Due to repeated Vajra attacks, the Frontier colonial fleet's resources are shortened. Energy becomes limited, and water and food rationing increases the population's unease.

19.o: Ranka's pet Ai-kun suddenly disappears. Ranka asks Brera for help and they look for Ai-kun together. Along the way, Brera asks Ranka who does she sing for? Ranka, who's beginning to feel doubt about her singing, starts to consider her true feelings. Meanwhile, Sheryl tells Alto that she will no longer sing.

20.o: At Ranka's concert in Mihoshi Academy Ranka, Alto and Sheryl meet. While their thoughts and feelings cross each other during the event, the Vajra attack and Ranka's group becomes caught in a very dangerous and deadly situation.

21.o: In the on-going war against the Vajra, people lose their loved ones and their hatred grows. Refusing to be a singing tool and wanting to clear up other people's thoughts, Ranka is determined to take a major step.

22.o: The Frontier populance's hatred of the Vajra is growing by leaps and bounds, and even Alto and Luka cannot control their own hate. Moreover, now armed with new prototype weapons, Alto and Luka consider using them to utterly exterminate all Vajra. However, Ozma (who has been researching Leon's conspiracy) is beginning to realise the identity of the real enemy behind the conflict. Meanwhile, Sheryl decides to sing again with a brand new perspective.

23.o:
Due to insufficient resources in the Frontier Fleet, food is being rationed. As even oxygen is being lowered inside the colony, Alto cooks for a V-virus infected Sheryl as they pass the time peacefully. Right after that, Alto receives a shocking revelation about the origin of the Vajra and the power behind Ranka's song from Mr. Bilrer and Leon Mishima.

24.o: The members of S.M.S Macross Quarter investigate the truth behind the destruction of the 117th Large Scale Research fleet in a Vajra attack and Ozma Lee finds the shadow of Grace O' Connor's ambition present in the incident where Ranka lost her family. Meanwhile, the NUNS military forces of Frontier prepare for a final decisive battle to protect the fleet from the Vajra.

25.o: After arriving at the planet of origin of the Vajra, the Frontier fleet commences an all-out attack and Battle Frontier manages to charge directly into the center of the enemy forces. However, Island One (the main residential area of the fleet) receives a fierce counterattack from the Vajra and becomes endangered. During that time of crisis, the silhouette of a person starts projecting on the stage at the Battle 25 bridge.

5.o: Phyr details her request to Limeskin, who refuses and asks Willem for a favor of his own.

6.o: Willem learns a lot from Souwong and makes a stand. Meanwhile, Chtholly continues to hear the voices in her head...

7.o: The warehouse has to deal with the ramifications of Chtholly's condition. At the same time, things begin to unravel on the surface.

8.o: As the situation on the surface continues to simmer, Chtholly struggles to come to terms with her new life.

9.o: Things continue to get worse for Chtholly, who bravely decides to live in the moment. Meanwhile, the rescue operation to the surface finally begins.

10.o: Chtholly helps out around the base as his secretary and gains the adulation of everyone there. Willem, on the other hand, starts having doubts about some unanswered questions after meeting Nopht and Rhantolk.

12.o: A desperate battle unfolds upon the Saxifraga as it tries to escape the attack of timere. Chtholly, clinging to the last pieces of emotions she still possesses, decides to fight.

1.o: We are introduced to the very unique Braveman family. Single mom Sarah, and her two kids Amber and Drew, are moving back home with Sarah's parents Zeek and Camille. 2.o: تنطلق المرأتان شمالًا إلى "كوينزلاند"، لكن سرعان ما يتمّ التعرف على "لولا" بعد نشر وكالات الأنباء صورتها وتقارير أن الشرطة تبحث عنها.

3.o: تُرغم "لولا" و"تشيلسي" على قضاء الليلة وسط الأحراش بعد نفاد الوقود بشكلٍ عرضي، دون أن تدركا أن قاتلًا مأجورًا يقترب منهما بسرعة.

5.o: تنصب "لولا" فخًا على مضمار السباق لاسترجاع السيارة المسروقة بعد حفل تخييم "باروما" في الغابة، ويرصد "جوش" وجود "تشيلسي" وسط المحتفلين.

3.o: تبحث "تشيلسي" و"لولا" عن ملاذ في منزل منعزل في مزرعة بعد أن يتبسّم لهما الحظّ قليلًا. ويعود ماضي المحقّقة الشرطيّة "ماكسين" لمطاردتها.

4.o: تجد "لولا" و"تشيلسي" "صوفي" فجأةً وتجتمعان بـ"دونا" فيما بعد، ولكن ليس كما خطّطتا... أمّا حبّ "ماكسين" للمال، فيقودها للقيام بخطوة جريئة.

5.o: تلجأ "تشيلسي" إلى صديق قديم للاختباء لديه، بينما تقرّر "لولا" زيارة والدتها. وتعلم "سوزان" بمكان ابنتها وتجد طريقةً لتجتمع بها مُجدّدًا.

6.o: تخالف "ماكسين" الموقوفة عن العمل الأوامر وتعقد اتفاقًا مع "سوزان"، وتحتجز "لولا" و"تشيلسي" رهينة للتفاوض على إطلاق سراح النساء المُتاجر بهن.

1.o: The four members of Rescue Force Sigma-17 emerge and are greeted by the Autobot leader Optimus Prime, who assigns them to work with the Burns family on an island. While the four are supposed to respond to every command the humans give them, they get fed up with it and are tempted to leave Earth. Until, an animatronic dinosaur attacks the island.

2.o: While Chase and Chief Burns pursue an out-of-control robo-landscaper through Griffin Rock, Cody Burns reports that the rest of the team might be delayed, as his siblings are having trouble coming to terms with the fact that their rescue vehicles are alien robots. A volcano suddenly threatens the island of Griffin Rock, sending the Rescue Bots and Burns family into action. The group has to put aside their differences and work together in order to save the island.

4.o: Flying lobsters invade a summer festival, and an angry Heatwave refuses to help fight them.

5.t: The Alien Invasion of Griffin Rock
5.o: The Rescue Bots are put in danger when a resident of Griffin Rock threatens to expose the secret of an "alien invasion.

6.o: Boulder decides that the team needs an animal mascot but maybe a zoo isn't the best place to find one.

7.o: Cody accidentally unleashes a swarm of futuristic nanites while he's trying to super-charge his go-kart to help in the team's rescue missions.

8.o: The Bots are enlisted to watch after Doc Greene's Robo-Baby.

9.o: Cody, his family and the Rescue Bots have to stop a snow storm in July when a weather machine goes haywire.

10.o: A shark targeting high-tech ocean equipment is spotted off the Griffin Rock shore.

12.o: A scientist tries to replace the team with a new invention, leaving everyone out of the action.

13.o: Cody looks for proof that the new scientist's invention is really a villainous plan.

14.o: The Rescue Bots are accidentally shrunk and the Burns family must work without their partners.

15.o: Cody finds a clue to an old mystery and makes a startling underwater discovery.

16.o: The Rescue Bots disobey the Chief's orders and find themselves in a life-threatening situation.

17.o: A storm strands Cody on a deserted island where they find a pirate ship that holds the key to a mystery.

18.o: Bumblebee pays the Rescue Bots a visit just in time to help investigate a mysterious meteor.

19.o: The Bots and Burns must stop a giant glob of space slime before it consumes the town.

20.o: Cody and the Rescue Bots try to solve the vanishing mystery when the residents of Griffin Rock start disappearing.

21.o: Ghosts haunt and terrorize the residents of Griffin Rock.

22.o: The kids are covertly planning a surprise birthday party for their father. Chief Burns tells them he is heading to the docks, but actually takes a trip to the bakery for a cake, as a present for his family, thinking that they forgot his birthday. Chase discovers this to be a lie and is confounded by this. While setting up the party back home, the kids and the other Rescue Bots realize that Chase and Chief Burns are missing, and search the entire town. Eventually they discover the two trapped inside an underground mine, and save them from the flooding water and falling rocks.

23.o: The Rescue Bots lead the rescue efforts when a series of earthquakes strike the island.

24.o: Doc Greene invents a repulsor badge that allows the wearer to be occluded from projectiles. Cody uses it to participate more on the front lines, in missions with the rest of his family, against Chief Burns concern of his safety. His superhero status, however, is halted when his repulsor badge is overloaded and projects a nonstop field, enclosing him inside. Boulder uses neutralizing gloves, also invented by Doc Greene, to bypass the repulsive field and successfully remove the badge from Cody, shortly before it detonates.

25.o: When Doc Greene's experiment with a time machine goes awry, the Bots end up being captured by an old nemesis.

26.o: When the Bots return home, they find that Doctor Morocco is in command of Griffin Rock.

1.o: Three years after we last saw our heroes, an alien attack forces the Rescue Bots to make a decision as to whether to reveal their true natures to the citizens of Griffin Rock.

2.o: The citizens of Griffin Rock are deciding whether or not to let the Bots stay in their midst when a GroundBridge accident splits the team.

3.o: As Frankie struggles to adjust to life with her baby sister, the Bots are surprised by a new arrival of their own.

4.o: When Heatwave invites her to take a turn at leadership, Quickshadow upsets the Rescue Team's dynamic.

5.o: When Chief is convinced by Cody to try a virtual reality video game, an old nemesis is uncovered; the team must stop the villain from destroying the real Griffin Rock.

6.o: The Bots deal with a group of investors who want to build a vacation resort in Griffin Rock, while Cody deals with feeling invisible around everyone.

7.o: As Griffin Rock celebrates its version of Halloween, Evan and Myles car-jack Quickshadow and discover the Bots' secret.

8.o: When the Rescue Bots are captured by a new villain, the Burns family finds an unexpected ally in a former enemy.

9.o: The town of Griffin Rock gets more than it bargained for when Chase is elected as the new mayor.

10.o: During a Cybertronian holiday, the Rescue Bots take on their biggest challenge yet - a super-sized, overtired baby.

11.o: When Griffin Rock's communication tower needs replacing, the Bots and Burnses take on part-time jobs to raise the money.

12.o: The Rescue Team struggles with last minute preparations as they finally open the mainland Training Center.

13.t: The More Things Stay the Same
13.o: The Bots' Mainland Training Center is in danger of being discovered and, to make matters worse, the Rescue Team is trapped inside with a glitching hologram.

14.o: Blurr is torn between his desire to be a winning racecar and a working Rescue Bot; Dani helps Blurr find balance.

15.o: Chief helps Woodrow rescue gorillas from a volcanic eruption; his sons learn they are heirs to the throne of Griffin Rock.

16.o: While at Griffin Rock's Pizza Pi Festival, Doc's new super-yeast causes chaos and the Bots have to find an unconventional solution to the rising problem.

17.o: When Bumblebee makes an unexpected appearance at the Bots' Training Center, he brings along more than a few surprises for the team.

18.o: When Blades is unable to participate in a Lad Pioneer leveling up ceremony on the mainland due to his Bot form, Graham and Cody help disguise him.

19.o: The Rescue Team is drawn into the woods to solve the mystery of what's making the Griffin Spruces fall.

20.o: A mysterious criminal and unexpected visitor challenge Blurr's future as a Rescue Bot.

21.o: Energon and technology have fallen into treacherous hands and it is up to the Burns family and their Bots to steal them back.

22.o: Kade's idol, an arrogant movie star, comes to Griffin Rock in preparation for a role, causing trouble for the Rescue Team while they try to solve a series of mysterious break-ins.

23.o: When Dani's out-of-this-world test flight doesn't go according to plan, the Rescue Team strives to ensure she makes it back home.

24.o: Cody rides along with each of the Bots to decide what kind of rescue worker he wants to be.

25.o: When Optimus Prime splits the Rescue Bots into different teams for new assignments, the evil genius Doctor Morocco returns to wreak havoc.

26.o: The computer-generated Doctor Morocco hatches a bold new plot to defeat the Rescue Bots by becoming one of them.

1.o: تدور أحداث حول (هادي أبو المكارم) الذي يجد نفسه فاقد للذاكرة بعد تعرضه لحادث ما، ومع مرور الوقت يتذكر بعض الأشياء، لكن الغريب أن شخصيته كانت تتغير عندما يظهر القمر في السماء، حتى أن ابنته تخاف من معاملته، كما يبدو أنه يشرب المخدرات والخمر بصورة كبيرة جدًا، فهل للقمر علاقة بشخصيته أم الخمر والمخدرات أم شيء آخر.
The peaceful Mexican town of San Simon and a trio of Daoist martial arts pupils are attacked by a mutated initiate from an occult crime organization.

2.o: Chiu's students are left reeling in the wake of their loss. El Balde summons his fellow jefes and transforms them into flesh-eating monsters.

3.o: Brister and Garcia seek clues to the origins of the demonic creatures while Isabela, Jesus and Silencio do the same as they mourn their fallen master.

4.o: After uncovering the truth about their peaceful town, Isabela and Jesus are arrested while Silencio becomes a fugitive. El Balde comes to San Simon.

5.o: El Balde terrorizes the town of San Simon while Chiu's students meet Lo, their former master's brother. Brister and Garcia try to rescue Garabina.

6.o: Lo's true nature emerges. Isabela, Silencio and Jesus join forces with Brister and Garcia to raid El Balde's compound and find his mother, Alejandra.

7.t: Between This World and the Next
7.o: An earth-shattering showdown unfolds between El Balde and his mother, Alejandra, who has possessed the body of Isabela. Silencio succumbs to anger.

8.o: The team battles a surprising nemesis with seemingly insurmountable powers. He reveals Chiu's secret past -- and offers Silencio a fateful choice.

1.t: Iron Forged in Fire: Part One
1.o: Tony Stark is left the sole survivor when his father's plane crashes. Now an orphan, he is presented with a questionable 'last request' of his father: live with the Rhodes and go to school. Encouraged by Pepper Potts and assisted by Jim Rhodes, the 16 year old genius begins to investigate the suspicious activities carried out by Obadiah Stane, the new C.E.O. of Stark Industries. But an even deadlier foe is waiting... The Mandarin.

2.t: Iron Forged in Fire: Part Two
2.o: Mandarin has trouble win his son, Gene Khan, while trying to retrieve the rings. Tony Stark as Iron Man battles his invention that Obadiah transformed into a weapon. Mandarin steals the ring of Obadiah, and fights Iron Man. Back in Mandarin's lair it is revealed that Gene Khan has become The Mandarin.

3.o: After Tony is captured by a secret organization, he learns that Gene's father has something to do with it.

4.o: Despite Rhodey's reservations, Iron Man builds an alliance with a man named Blizzard. Wanting to take out Obadiah Stane, Tony feels that the new partnership will be beneficial. But is Blizzard all that he seems to be?

5.o: When Pepper's father is targeted by arms dealer Mister Fix, Tony must save the day without revealing his secret. However, this task becomes nearly impossible when Mister Fix sends his agent Whiplash after Pepper.

6.t: Iron Man VS The Crimson Dynamo
6.o: Ivan Vanko, a scientist who was thought to have been left in space two years ago, crash lands in New York City. Alive because of an environmental suit, called the Crimson Dynamo, Vanko seeks revenge on the program that put him in space in the first place- Project Pegasus. It's up to Iron Man to stop Vanko from destroying Project Pegasus.

7.o: The pressures of living a normal teenage life and being Iron Man become too much for Tony. Deciding he doesn't need school anymore, Tony quits and focuses on saving the world as Iron Man full time. But when a new villain, called the Living Laser, appears, Tony learns that he has to graduate in order to take over Stark Industries.

8.o: Tony sneaks into Stark International to catch a glimpse of the new Stealth Armor. Unfortunately, the building locks down and Tony is stuck inside. With the help of Rhodey and Pepper, Tony must find a way out of the building without revealing his secret identity.

9.o: Tony and his friends' search for the ancient Makluan Rings goes awry when the guardians of the Rings, the Dreadknights, arrive.

10.o: During the school science fair, Tony is approached by the leaders of an organization known as the Advanced Idea Mechanics. Offering up his help, Tony inadvertantly creates a new enemy, the Controller. With Tony's friends under its control, Iron Man must step in and save the day.

11.o: When Obadiah Stane starts acting strangely, Iron Man investigates. It turns out that Madame Masque, a shape shifting villain, was posing as Obadiah and she has a new target: Iron Man. Now, Tony must clear Iron Man's name after the police come looking for him.

12.o: Project Pegasus, under the control of Obadiah Stane, creates an upgraded version of the Crimson Dynamo. With it, they capture Iron Man and begin analyzing the suit. After Rhodey and Pepper bust Iron Man out, Tony is ready for revenge. This time, Iron Man takes on the Crimson Dynamo with help from his new upgrade- the Dynamo Buster Armor.

13.o: When Tony and Gene find the third Makluan Ring, they argue over what exactly to do with it. Taking matters into his own hands, Gene accidentally unlocks the ring's guardian, Ultimo. Iron Man tries to detain Ultimo, but is forced to deal with the return of the Mandarin as well.

14.o: The Iron Man suit malfunctions during an update when fighting Whiplash. When the armor goes online by itself, Tony is stuck inside. Unable to find a way out, Tony fears that he'll never be able to leave Iron Man behind.

15.o: When Iron Man tracks Moses Magnum to A.I.M.'s secret headquarters, he meets someone else who's after Magnum, the Black Panther. Thinking they'll be able to work together, Iron Man goes to the Black Panther for help. Unfortunately, Black Panther is only after Magnum and threatens to reveal Tony's secret if he gets in the way.

16.o: When the Living Laser threatens the Earth via a space satellite, Iron Man steps in to save the day. Soon, however, Nick Fury and S.H.I.E.L.D. contact Tony and tell him not to interfere. Not knowing who to fully trust, Tony is left feeling unsure of what to do.

17.o: When the Ghost comes after Tony, Madame Masque mysteriously steps in to protect him. Fearing that his friends will get hurt, Tony begins to push them away. Unfortunately, the Ghost captures Madame Masque and Tony is forced to call on his friends for help.

18.o: When Pepper gets caught up in the middle of a feud between the Tong and the Maggia, the Mandarin calls on an unlikely source for help - Iron Man.

19.o: After Tony accidentally creates an evil virus known as Technovore, he believes that it is gone for good. Unfortunately, the virus grows bigger and sets its sights on Iron Man.

20.o: Upon retrieving the fourth Makluan Ring, Gene recalls memories of his mother and his birthright. The guardian of said Ring, Firebrand, traps Pepper and Rhodey inside an active volcano and Iron Man must get them out before it erupts.

21.o: A.I.M. uses a dying Living Laser to power up their newest creation- the Mental Organism Designed Only for Conquest. When Iron Man can't beat MODOC's mental powers, it's up to the Living Laser to save his life.

22.o: After Tony lets Rhodey take the Iron Man suit out for a spin, it falls into the hands of Happy Hogan. Now, Tony must help Hogan take down a Maggia plot, all while not revealing his secret.

23.o: The Controller uses a boy named Rick Jones to get the Hulk to take revenge on A.I.M. Stepping in, Iron Man is taken over by the Controller and only the Hulk can stop him.

24.o: Obadiah Stane calls on Tony to find a cure for his daughter Whitney's disease. Knowing of a cure that exists in an abandoned Stark facility in the Arctic, Iron Man heads off to find it. Unable to sit around and do nothing, Stane forces Blizzard to go get the cure as well.

25.o: Zhang, Gene Khan's father and the former Mandarin, captures Tony and his friends in order to retrieve all five Makluan Rings. When the guardian of the fifth ring is released, the mighty dragon Fin Fang Foom becomes quite a challenge for the gang. Will Tony and Gene be able to save the day without the help of the Iron Man suit or the other Makluan Rings?

26.o: Doning the War Machine suit, Rhodey arrives just in time to save his friends from Fin Fang Foom. Now, it's the battle of the century as Iron Man and War Machine face off against Fin Fang Foom and the Mandarin.

1.o: The series opens on Jim Hawkins as an adult, a doctor on an English ship stopped in the bay of an island. The captain shows Jim a grave he found of a pirate, Long John Silver. Jim remembers this old friend Long John. He starts to tell the captain of his past adventures sailing with him.

2.o: Jim and his mother are homeless and without work. On the intercession of the good Dr. Livesey, Squire Trelawney welcomes them to his property. Jim shows them the map leading to the treasure of Captain Flint.

3.o: Together they set sail for Bristol. On the ship Silver teaches Jim small lessons of easy seafaring. Meanwhile, Shadow keeps a close eye on the navigation of the Hispaniola thanks to his spy and a traveler-raven that keeps them in contact.

4.o: Jim discovers the truth about Long John and his secret agenda. Jim tries to warn Captain Smollett of the pirates and their plans of mutiny.

5.o: Jim and his friends go to save JoJo from the pirates. However, the pirates spot them before they can run away. They are saved by a man hidden in the forest.

6.o: Jim and his friends are fugitives running from Governor Blade and Shadow as well as zombies! Jim and friends take back control of the ship.

7.o: Jim, friends and Silver attempt to flee from Jamaica. Governor Blade is on a search for all of them. The fugitives hide out in the palace.

8.o: Jim and friends manage to escape the governor and all his men. Silver wants to guide them to Tortuga, a safe haven for pirates.

9.o: They depart from the island of Tortuga. Jim enters a life he is not prepared for. But Jim might just have what it takes to be a true Captain.

10.o: Blade is planning to attach with zombies. JoJo knows regular weapons won't be enough to defeat them.

11.o: Blade's true identity is revealed. Jim and crew continue to flee. Long John leads them to a secret passage where they may rest.

12.o: Guided by JoJo, they search for his mother Kainda, who will help them defeat the zombies. However, Shadow has his own plans that will lead him to Africa as well.

13.o: Shadow takes on an old enemy and tries to make a deal with Kainda. Ben is anxious about all that is happening and may know more than it seems.

14.o: Long John leads Jim and friends on an escape. Meanwhile, Governor Blade is acting increasingly strange and angry.

15.o: Jim and crew find Kainda. With her magic, they will now be able to fight the zombies.

16.o: Devastated, JoJo goes to search for Mama Kainda's body in the water. Jim follows but soon after, both must retreat to the ship. Blade and Shadow are close on their tail. Jim spots a wandering zombie and decides they must capture him to warn the rest of the world.

17.o: Half of the crew ventures onto the island to capture the zombie. Meanwhile the ship and the rest of the crew are hiding from Blade. Jim and friends must conquer quicksand and other obstacles of the tropical forest to get the wandering zombie to the ship.

18.o: Jim and crew sail for Veracruz to reveal the zombie to the authorities. Shadow sends out his ravens to locate Jim's ship. Flint is injured.

19.o: Jim wants to return to Veracruz to retrieve the Codex. The crew is nervous for Jim but aids him in preparation for his plan. Jim and Flint are on their own.

20.o: Jim retrieved the Codex and returned to his friends. Soon after, Jim and crew run into Pirates from different parts of the world all out for the feat of the Great Golden fleet, the largest shipment of gold in history. Jim and Silver think it is a trap.

21.o: Governor Blade has rallied his allied fleets to declare war on the Pirates. The Chinese Pirates are the only ones that believe Jim and his friends about the impending doom. They gift Tracy a brand new ship. They are ready for the challenge.

22.o: Jim and crew must now fight many more zombies. JoJo is struggling to control his anger and hatred but Jim is going to help him. Meanwhile, Shadow has come across new knowledge to complete his evil grand plan.

23.o: Jim and crew search for Kainda. Huracan is getting closer to achieving his vengeance carried out by Blade.

24.o: Jim thinks they must travel to Skull Island. Ben is scared. Kainda helps reveal his knowledge of the island and Huracan to the others.

25.o: Jim wants to reach Huracan and convince him to stop his evil plan of revenge. Blade is determined to achieve vengeance for both Huracan and himself.

26.o: Skull Island is the location for the final challenge between good and evil, between Jim and friends and Flint/Blade with a crew of zombies. Who will prevail?

1.o: Teenage student-journalist, Charlie Chambers, pieces together the clues of a vicious double-homicide in the summer of 1995. Friends and loved ones of the deceased struggle to make sense of their new, grief-stricken reality.

2.o: Detective Darlene Grasso begins her investigation into the murders of Chrissy Monroe and Steve Carpenter. Aided by Charlie’s discovery, she zeros in on one suspect, in particular: Brad Kirchoff, Chrissy’s boyfriend.

3.o: Charlie convinces the newspaper editor, Mr. Bouque, to let him write about the murder. A conversation between Charlie and Becky in the woods rekindles their spark of connection. The killer dials Chrissy’s private line.

4.o: The students of Colfax High partake in the homecoming dance while Detective Grasso interrogates Casper Tatum.

5.t: Notes From The Wrong Side of The Tracks
5.o: Casper finally realizes the identity of his secret crush, Becky Monroe, is the sister of a girl everyone thinks he murdered. A late-night encounter in the newspaper room provides Charlie with the scoop of his young career.

6.o: After Charlie’s article in the school paper exonerates Casper, an unlikely romance blossoms between the town bad boy and Becky Monroe.

7.o: Becky shares an intimate secret with Casper during a long walk home as Brad secretly plots his revenge. A flyer to a mysterious party is delivered in everyone’s lockers overnight. Charlie and Berlice’s relationship intensifies as the party begins.

8.o: Brad and Casper get into a bloody and vicious brawl at a Halloween party. After Brad is left clinging to life, Casper has no choice but to flee town.

9.o: Becky reemerges from her self-imposed exile to borrow books from Charlie. Their renewed friendship gets in the way of the young scribe’s relationship with Berlice.

10.o: Just as Colfax is finally beginning to heal, another murder shakes the city to its core. Years later, adult Charlie mulls over what it all meant at his high school reunion.

1.o: Nine contestants must re-invent their glam drag looks using thrift store clothing and tschotchkes from the 99-cent store. Guest judge Bob Mackie stops by to help RuPaul weed out the drag queen with the least style.

2.o: Wigs fly when the contestants split up into 2 rival girl groups, something guest judge Michelle Williams of Destiny's Child would know plenty about. Can the girls impress RuPaul with their lip-synching skills?

3.o: The queens are tested on their multi-media prowess as they show off their talents as newscaster, product spokesperson, and talk show host to RuPaul and guest judge Debra Wilson of MADtv.

4.o: Hoping to follow in the footsteps of MAC Cosmetics' first Viva Glam girl, RuPaul, the queens make their own Viva Glam screen test. Jenny Shimizu joins the panel to help judge the girls' drag queen status.

5.o: The contestants make over a group of female extreme fighters into their drag daughters. Xena herself, Lucy Lawless, makes a guest appearance to judge the girls' combat prowess.

6.o: RuPaul makes the queens hit the floor in a good old fashioned drag ball inspired by Absolut's real fruit flavored vodkas.

7.o: Look back at the highlights, lowlights, and previously unseen footage from the first six episodes as we race toward the climactic grand finale!

8.o: The last 3 queens face their final challenge while shooting the music video for RuPaul's new single "Cover Girl (Put The Bass In Your Walk)." Out artist Cazwell stops by to help the judges cast their final vote.

9.o: In this reunion special, all nine contestants return to give their take on what happened during the show. Plus, the girls confront the judges...and each other!

1.o: Twelve new queens compete to be America's Next Drag Superstar! The queens must reinvent their drag looks using only a set of curtains and household items. Guest judges include comedienne Kathy Griffin & photographer Mike Ruiz.

2.o: The dolls make it rain when they compete as burlesque dancers at a hot Hollywood nightclub and weather an unexpected twist. RuPaul is joined by guest judges comedienne Kim Coles and international burlesque star Dita Von Teese.

3.o: The queens split off into teams to film a country-fried commercial directed by Kathy Najimy who's joined on the panel by guest judge country music legend Tanya Tucker.

4.o: The dolls compete in a star-studded tv game show where they must pull out their best celebrity impersonations. Guests include actor Alec Mapa, red carpet diva Phoebe Price & guest judges comedienne Niecy Nash and actress Lisa Rinna.

5.o: Wedding bells ring as the queens go from blushing brides to dragzillas in a challenge that weds their drag personas with the perfect grooms - themselves. Singer/songwriter Martha Walsh & makeup artist Mathu Andersen help judge.

6.o: The queens rock out on the main stage when they're challenged to sing live for the first time ever in RuPaul's Drag Race history.

7.o: The dolls must sell their tales as they pose for a book cover photoshoot and hit the press junket circuit. E!'s Marc Malkin is joined by best-selling authors Jackie Collins & Gigi Levangie Grazer & Absolut Vodka's Jeffrey Moran.

8.o: The queens must transform a group of silver daddies into their drag mothers in this NYX Cosmetics challenge. They're joined by guest judges Debbie Reynolds & Cloris Leachman as well as NYX Cosmetics founder Toni Ko.

9.o: The final four queens hit the red carpet and pull out all the stops as they create looks for three separate divalicious award shows. Guest judges include Academy Award winner Tatum O'Neal and Tony Award winner Marissa Jaret Winokur.

10.o: A look back on the highlights, low-lights, and previously unseen footage from the first nine episodes as we race toward the climactic grand finale!

11.o: The last three queens face their final challenge - shooting the music video for RuPaul's next single "Jealous of My Boogie." Guests include reality star Robert Verdi, make-up artist Mathu Anderson and choreographer Ryan Heffington.

12.o: The contestants' tasks include being a newscaster, product spokesperson and talk-show host to RuPaul and guest judge Debra Wilson.

1.o: What does it really take to become America's next drag superstar? From fabulous divas to outrageous flops, RuPaul gives a behind-the-scenes look at casting for Drag Race.

2.o: Aren't the holidays such a drag? Brighten up your night with a fierce Christmas challenge on tonight's RuPaul's Drag Race. The claws come out in the first challenge of the season when the girls are asked to create a holiday look with nothing but some tinsel, ornaments and a little well placed mistletoe. Guest Judges: Vanessa Williams / Mike Ruiz

3.o: The queens face the final frontier as they shoot two out-of-this-world sci-fi movie trailers. RuPaul is joined by extra special guest judges the legendary Lily Tomlin and Caprica's Alessandra Torresani.

4.o: The girls get physical as they produce their own inspirational workout videos directed by fitness guru Susan Powter. RuPaul & Susan Powter are joined by extra special guest judge La Toya Jackson.

5.o: The queens get a wake up call in the competition when they're asked to produce two morning news shows. RuPaul is joined by extra special guest judges Big Love's Chloë Sevigny and Debbie Matenoupolous.

6.o: The queens compete in a star-studded TV game show where they must pull out their best celebrity impersonations. RuPaul is joined by extra special guest judges actress-comedienne Aisha Tyler & Amber Rose.

7.o: The queens look good enough to eat in this episode where they're challenged to find fashion inspiration from the world of cakes. RuPaul is joined by extra special guest judges actress Eliza Dushku & Sara Rue.

8.o: The queens perform stand-up comedy routines in front of a live studio audience. RuPaul is joined by extra special guest judges comedienne Rita Rudner and MADTV's Arden Myrin.

9.t: Life, Liberty & the Pursuit of Style
9.o: Get ready for a red, white, and blue spectacular! In this patriotic challenge, the queens are tasked with creating heartfelt and hilarious video messages to uplift our troops. RuPaul is joined by extra special guest judges Cheryl Tiegs and Johnny Weir.

10.o: The dolls record a single and perform before a live audience. RuPaul is joined by extra special guest judges Jody Watley & Carmen Electra.

11.o: The queens wig out when they have to compete in a fantasy hair show. RuPaul is joined by extra special guest judges American Idol Fantasia Barrino & comedian-TV host Wayne Brady.

1.t: My Code - To Make Everyone Happy with My Singing
1.o:
“My mission is to bring happiness to everyone with my singing.”

Vivy was created as the world’s first autonomous humanoid AI and works at the NiaLand theme park. Her mission is “to make everyone happy with her singing.” While she is singing on stage, she comes into contact with an AI that calls himself Matsumoto. Amidst her confusion, he asks for her help to rewrite history together, in order to stop the war between AI and humans that will happen one hundred years later.

2.t: Quarter Note – The Beginning of the One Hundred-Year Journey
2.o:
“Your one hundred-year journey starts here.”

One of the causes of the war between AI and humans that will happen one hundred years later, is the death of a politician named Aikawa. The anti-AI terrorist group “Toak” tries to assault Assemblyman Aikawa, but Vivi and Matsumoto take action to prevent this tragedy from happening. However, Vivy has no way of retaliating against the relentless attack of the terrorists since she was created to be a singer, and they find themselves backed into a corner…

3.t: A Tender Moon Tempo – A Pleasant Chat with the Stars
3.o:
“Relax and enjoy a pleasant conversation with the stars.”

After the incident with Assemblyman Aikawa, more people start coming to see Vivy perform on stage. One day, Matsumoto appears before Vivy again, and urges her to get on board the Sunrise space hotel with him. While they travel to outer space, Vivy is conflicted by the gap between what she must do and her true mission.

4.o:
“I’m bringing this child safely back to earth no matter what.”

Estella, an AI that works at space hotel Sunrise, is suspected of attempting to make the hotel crash into Earth. However, as Vivy interacts with Estella and gets to know her better, she begins to see a difference between the information given to her by Matsumoto about Estella. Meanwhile, someone takes control over the Sunrise hotel much quicker than what Matsumoto predicted. Amidst the confusion, Vivy investigates the cause of the situation in order to save the passengers and Momoka’s younger sister, Yuzuka.

5.t: Sing My Pleasure – To Make You Smile
5.o:
“I want to protect your smile, because you love AIs.”

After the Sunrise incident, the audiences for Vivy’s stage performances grow day by day. Matsumoto appears once again in front of Vivy and informs her that AI technology is advancing quicker than what was recorded in history. In order to stop this, he states that their new mission will be to shut down the unmanned plant on the ocean, Metal Float. Matsumoto and Vivy rush to meet the researcher who helped to build this plant.

6.t: Sing My Pleasure – I Love You
6.o:
“I humbly accept. I look forward to a long-lasting relationship.”

Using a termination program given to them by Dr. Saeki, Vivy and Matsumoto use it to shut down the activity of Metal Float. However, this causes the AI that governs the island to go completely out of control, and it engages in battle with Toak when they try to attack the island. With “AIs attacking humans” now a fait accompli, Vivy rescues the members of Toak, and heads to the center of the island to prevent further havoc by the AI.

7.t: Galaxy Anthem – To Make Everyone Happy With My Singing
7.o:
“I’ll perform perfectly as usual. To bring happiness to everyone with my singing.”

Diva’s daily performances on the main stage are sold out, and she has cemented her position as the indisputable AI songstress of NiaLand. She is invited to perform at the Zodiac Signs Festival, which will feature AI singers from around the world, but is pulled into a precarious situation during the rehearsal. At that moment, a cube-shaped AI that she has never seen before appears in front of her and…

8.t: Elegy Dedicated With Love – My One and Only Beloved Partner
8.o:
“Nothing is more important than singing an amazing song…that will allow me to fulfill my life’s mission.”

Diva is astonished when she hears from Matsumoto that Vivy’s mission is to prevent a war between humanity and AIs. He also explains to Diva that his current aim is to stop Ophelia from taking her own life. Ophelia is a songstress AI who just finished an incredible performance during rehearsal. As a principle, AIs are forbidden from self-destruction, so Diva approaches Ophelia to prevent her from committing suicide.

9.t: Harmony of One's Heart – My Mission, Your Future
9.o:
“Hey, can you hear me? Don’t you think this song I’m singing sounds beautiful?”

The ugly truth behind the tragedy that has befallen Ophelia, is that her support AI, Antonio, has taken over her body. With his identity blown, Antonio attacks Matsumoto in order to hide Ophelia’s truth. Kakitani captures Diva and confesses his hatred for AIs while forcibly trying to awaken Vivy who is inside of her. Will Diva and Matsumoto be able to safely fix the Singularity Point…?

10.t: Vivy Score – Singing From My Heart

“I fulfilled my promise, Diva.”
